description: Direct downstream-classifier comparison: the saved CNN-LSTM neural head versus the already-trained StandardScaler/PCA/SVM branch for each backbone. Deltas are PCA+SVM minus neural head.
important_interpretation: This is not a PCA-only ablation. StandardScaler, PCA and SVM form the alternative downstream classification branch.

vgg16.comparison_scope: Same saved CNN-LSTM experiment; neural 4-class head versus saved StandardScaler/PCA(64)/linear-SVM downstream branch. No retraining or refitting performed by this script.

vgg19.comparison_scope: Same saved CNN-LSTM experiment; neural 4-class head versus saved StandardScaler/PCA(64)/linear-SVM downstream branch. No retraining or refitting performed by this script.

resnet50.comparison_scope: Same saved CNN-LSTM experiment; neural 4-class head versus saved StandardScaler/PCA(64)/linear-SVM downstream branch. No retraining or refitting performed by this script.
